title: ImUi Text Input Custom Filter Policy v1
problem: Close the Fret-native equivalent of Dear ImGui `CallbackCharFilter` for single-line IMUI input text by adding a composable custom insertion filter above the existing runtime mechanism, without exposing mutable buffer callbacks or moving policy into `fret-imui`.

repro.summary: A single-line IMUI input can combine named filters with a custom insertion filter; named filters run first and the custom filter receives the named-filtered insertion text.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-imui input_text_custom_filter input_text_named_filters input_text_numeric_filters --no-fail-fast

gates.name: imui custom filter tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-imui input_text_custom_filter input_text_named_filters input_text_numeric_filters --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This custom insertion-filter slice is closed. Undo/redo command routing is tracked by `imui-text-input-undo-command-policy-v1`, and the first visible completion/history picker recipe is tracked by `imui-text-input-picker-recipe-v1`. Start separate follow-ons for active-descendant picker keyboard navigation or deeper multiline behavior; do not introduce Dear ImGui mutable-buffer callbacks into the runtime.
